remaining_census.scope: Unchanged-source and byte-identical cached HTML only. Seventy-two reviewed native/file/string/Biopython/OpenMM/MDTraj/MDAnalysis articles have incremental receiving; this census is not a newly rebuilt full site or installed/scientific certificate.

semantic_review: Declared attributes and registered direct routes are distinguished from per-instance data and operational availability. Topology has three registered conversion routes, not the two in the old micro-contract.
Unavailable add/merge/append hooks and absent setters are explicit. The PDBParser topology iterator is a placeholder; parser copying reopens the same filename and same-form subsets are refused.
MDAnalysis residues map to groups; native Topology and ChemicalStates retain their separate ownership. Parent-view copy order is distinct from native canonical sorted/unique atom inventory.

Provider coordinates/velocities/time carry explicit angstrom/picosecond units through PyUnitWizard. Universe iteration first materializes selected native data, then yields chunks; it is not bounded file streaming.

The shared reference verifier handles normalized documentation owner names, real zero-byte/whitespace module headers and callable converter delivery. A negative control rejects a fabricated conversion to an empty setter module; metadata-only export cannot certify an executable route.
failure_disposition: Initial eight MDAnalysis source/declaration checks pass. The first four-page strict build also passes; the later build adds explicit conversion counts needed by the established receiving contract.

The first joint 263-case run has 84 failures and 179 passes. An overbroad verifier change treats every whitespace-only module as zero-byte and rejects previously valid physical-line-1 anchors. This is a test-verifier defect, not 84 adapter regressions.

The correction retains valid physical header anchors, admits header-only links only for empty metadata modules, and independently requires every converter module to export its actual callable. The negative empty-converter control and all 263 joint cases pass.
limits: The runtime cohort covers the three existing AtomGroup/Topology/Universe test directories in the retained MDAnalysis 2.10.0 composition. PDBParser limits are source-reviewed; this does not certify every parser input or a provider minimum.

All 72 reviewed actual form articles receive intended references; the wider unchanged-cache census still has fourteen flagged external-class pages / 282 nodes among twenty-two source-matched byte-identical articles. It is not a new full-site build.

No runtime adapter, algorithm, public signature, optional dependency, native binary or storage schema changes. No complete-source/nightly or final installed-pair gate is supplied, and no original-score bonus or publication resumption follows.
